title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer – AI Applications**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Employment Type: Full-Time, On-site**

**Experience: 4+ Years**

**Expected CTC: ₹ 10–12 LPA**

**About SAITC**

SAITC is an AI software development company based in Saudi Arabia, focused on building

production-grade AI solutions for businesses.

We build AI chatbots, RAG applications, AI agents, AI-powered SaaS products, enterprise

integrations, and custom AI software.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of the backend

architecture and software engineering behind these solutions.

**Role Overview**

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will design and build production software, make architectural decisions, work closely with our Applied AI team, review code, and guide other engineers. The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with practical AI application experience who understands how to turn AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and production-ready software.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Backend Engineering & Architecture**

● Design scalable backend architectures for AI applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, and

enterprise solutions.

● Build production services primarily using Python and FastAPI.

● Design REST APIs, business logic, databases, integrations, and background processes.

● Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases and data models.

● Build integrations with third-party APIs, ERP/CRM systems, Odoo, and customer databases.

● Design secure multi-tenant systems with proper customer data isolation.

**2. AI Application Engineering**

● Work closely with Applied AI Engineers to integrate AI capabilities into production software.

● Build applications using LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, and

AI-powered workflows.

● Integrate providers such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, OCI Generative AI, and open-source

models.

● Design APIs and backend workflows around AI services, including streaming, retries,

fallbacks, and cost/latency considerations.

● Ensure AI systems are securely integrated with customer and business data.

**3. Technical Leadership**

● Establish coding and architectural standards across projects.

● Conduct code reviews and maintain high engineering quality.

● Mentor engineers and provide technical direction.

● Convert business and client requirements into practical technical solutions.

● Participate in technical discussions with founders and clients when required.

**4. Security, Testing & Quality**

● Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, tenant isolation, and API security.

● Ensure appropriate unit, integration, and API testing for backend services.

● Work closely with the DevOps/QA Engineer on deployment, monitoring, testing, and

production issues.

**Required Skills & Experience**

● 4+ years of professional software development experience.

● Strong experience with Python and FastAPI.

● Strong PostgreSQL and database design skills.

● Strong understanding of backend architecture and REST APIs.

● Experience building and deploying production software.

● Practical experience with LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents.

● Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security.

● Experience with Docker and Linux.

● Strong Git/GitHub experience.

● Good understanding of asynchronous programming, APIs, queues, and caching.

● Strong problem-solving and debugging ability.

● Ability to lead technical decisions and mentor other engineers.

Good to Have

● Redis / Celery / RabbitMQ / Kafka

● AWS / OCI / GCP / Azure

● Kubernetes / Terraform

● Experience building AI SaaS products

● Experience with enterprise integrations

● Experience working directly with clients

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6–12 months, you will help SAITC establish a strong technical foundation where:

● AI applications follow consistent and scalable architectures.

● Backend components can be reused across products and clients.

● AI services integrate cleanly with business applications and data.

● Customer data is securely isolated.

● Engineering standards and code quality improve across the team.

● SAITC can build and deliver new AI solutions faster.

**Education**

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of professional experience do you have in software engineering?

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have building AI applications?

* The expected compensation range for this role is INR 10-12 LPA. Are you comfortable with this range?

description:
**About NCR VOYIX**

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Title : Senior Software Engineer**

**Job Location : Hyderabad**

**Job Description**

The Software Engineer – Full Stack Developer on the NCR Voyix Insight Team is responsible for the technical design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-scale applications supporting the Insight and SWIC platforms.

Insight is a cloud-based Big Data analytics platform that delivers business intelligence, reporting, and data insights to customers using Google Cloud technologies, while SWIC is a web-based application supporting operational and business workflows. This role requires expertise in full-stack application development, cloud-native technologies, data analytics, and AI-assisted software engineering practices.

**Key Areas of Responsibility:**

1.Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of scalable full-stack applications supporting the Insight and SWIC platforms.

2.Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Quality Engineering, Architecture, and Operations, to define requirements and deliver business solutions.

3.Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, promoting engineering excellence, and fostering team growth.

4.Contribute to architectural discussions, technology evaluations, and technical decisions, ensuring alignment with product and organizational strategy.

5.Participate and contribute to an effective software development lifecycle using Agile and Scrum methodologies.

6.Implement and promote software engineering best practices, including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, code quality, security, and observability.

7.Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring optimal application performance, reliability, scalability, and availability.

8.Leverage AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and other intelligent engineering capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity.

9.Explore, evaluate, and implement AI-driven capabilities, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics solutions across the Insight and SWIC platforms.

10.Document technical designs, architecture decisions, implementation approaches, operational procedures, and system specifications clearly and concisely.

11.Support internal and external customers by investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving application and production issues.

12.Contribute to cloud deployments and operational excellence initiatives utilizing Google Cloud Platform services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and Apigee.

**Job Qualifications**:

  

* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and IAM.
* Experience developing and supporting Big Data analytics and reporting applications.
* Experience building highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native applications.
* Knowledge of Looker and LookML for data modelling, dashboard development, and analytics solutions.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Cloud builds, Terraform, & Helm.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, or similar technologies.
* Experience implementing automated testing frameworks and behaviors-driven development practices.
* Experience working in analytics, retail technology, or enterprise software domains.

* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana or similar) so issues are found early.
* Lead incident response and write blameless post-incident reviews. Follow up until the fixes are done.
* Automate repetitive work to reduce manual effort.
* Work with security and governance teams so the platform meets policy, using Azure Policy, RBAC, and guardrails.
Mentor engineers and share good practices across the team.  

**What you bring**

* 6–9 years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (networking, identity, storage, compute, and governance).
* Good working knowledge of CAF and Azure landing zones.
* Strong Terraform skills, with proven delivery of production IaC.
* Solid DevOps practices: Git workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Scripting or coding skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Good understanding of observability, incident management, and capacity planning.
* Clear communication and a habit of working well with others.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Azure Log Analytics and writing KQL queries for troubleshooting, dashboards, and alerts.
* Experience with data services such as Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse, or Data Lake.
* Kubernetes (AKS) and containers.
* Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-305, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
Experience in a regulated industry, such as financial services or insurance.  

**Why join us**
  
You will work on a platform that matters, with real ownership and room to shape how we do things. We value learning, automation, and a healthy on-call culture.

**About MetLife**  
  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  
  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

  

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. title: Software Development Manager
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line.  
  
Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it.  
  
What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience.  
  
You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates.  
  
Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities.  
  
Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion.  
  
Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them.  
  
Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership.  
  
Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises.  
  
Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases.  
  
A day in the life  
Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1:1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.

* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

title: Senior BI Developer

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
--------------------

* Strong SQL skills, including experience developing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, and transformations.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, data warehousing, semantic layers, and BI performance optimization.

* Experience with embedded analytics, deployment pipelines, Direct Lake, lakehouses, warehouses, or dataflows.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, C#, APIs, or metadata-driven automation for BI development and operations.
* Knowledge of automated testing, data-quality frameworks, observability, capacity planning, workload optimization, or refresh management.
* Experience creating AI-assisted workflows, agents, copilots, or reusable accelerators for software, data, or BI development.

---------------------------

* Dashboards, reports, and semantic models are accurate, reliable, performant, and easy for stakeholders to use.
* BI delivery becomes faster and more consistent through reusable assets, standards, documentation, and automation.
* Data validation, release quality, and production support improve through disciplined testing and clear ownership.
* AI-assisted development is used responsibly to reduce manual effort while maintaining strong human review, security, and quality guardrails.
* Business users have clearer, more trusted access to the insights they need to make decisions.

  

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset

* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role description**

Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)

Location: UST Hyderabad

Type: Full time, in-house

About the role

Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write

audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green

deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.

We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You

will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

* + You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)

* + AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional

* + Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

* + A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have

* + Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.

* + Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.

* + FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.

* + Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like

2.Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.

3.A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.

4.The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.

5.Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

  
**Skills**

AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

title: Platform Software Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Type

Full Time

Workspace

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a backend and systems engineer to build the software that receives, authenticates and manages IoT traffic at the edge. You will customise an open-source LoRaWAN network server and build the services around it: device registry, join and key handling, event pipelines and resilient relay services. All of it must run offline and on modest hardware, and survive power and link loss.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect, in a team that values testing, clean interfaces and reliability.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Network and Join Services**

* Customise an **open-source LoRaWAN network server** (for example ChirpStack): message-processing pipeline, de-duplication, integrity and frame-counter checks, join handling, device profiles and regional configuration.
* Extend it for new device and radio capabilities, and keep the fork **maintainable**: upstream rebases, a patch queue and regression tests.

#### **Edge and Offline Services**

* Build **event pipelines over MQTT** with durable queues, idempotent handling and the outbox pattern.
* Use **SQLite** (WAL, durability and integrity settings) and PostgreSQL appropriately, and Redis or Valkey where needed.
* Design **store-and-forward relays** that retry safely and never duplicate.
* Meet tight memory and CPU budgets.

#### **APIs, Security and Keys**

* Design **gRPC and REST APIs** with protobuf and OpenAPI, including schema evolution.
* Implement **mutual TLS, role-based access and audit trails**.
* Build a **device registry** with signed, versioned device lists, and key custody through encrypted keystores or HSM/PKCS#11, with an offline PKI.

#### **Deployability and Operations**

* **Cross-compile** for aarch64, armv7 and x86\_64, and ship both as containers and as plain packages.
* Make builds **reproducible and offline-capable**, produce an SBOM, and scan licences (for example with cargo-deny).
* Add **observability**: structured logs, metrics and tracing (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

#### **Testing**

* Build device and gateway **simulators**, property-based and fuzz tests, load and soak tests, and **fault injection** (power loss, link loss, clock jumps, full disk).

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** of backend or systems software.
* Strong in Rust or Go (or modern C++), and willing to become strong in Rust quickly.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Languages and Systems**

* Rust or Go, Linux internals, async I/O, concurrency and memory behaviour.

#### **Messaging and Storage**

* MQTT (including v5), SQL, SQLite and PostgreSQL, Redis or Valkey.

#### **APIs and Security**

* gRPC and protobuf, TLS and mTLS, JWT/OIDC, secrets handling.

#### **Delivery**

* Docker and OCI images, cross-compilation, CI/CD, flame-graph profiling.

#### **Quality**

* Unit, integration, contract and fuzz testing.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* LoRaWAN protocol knowledge or ChirpStack code experience.
* Small-footprint services (a few hundred MB of RAM) or offline deployments.
* Awareness of open-source licence risks (MIT, Apache, AGPL, source-available).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Own a core service of a real network, from code to deployment, with senior architectural guidance and a team that cares about testing and reliability.

### **How to Apply**

Send your updated resume along with links to relevant projects, GitHub or portfolio work to **jobs@eurthtech.com**, or use the application form on this page.

**About the Company**
---------------------

About EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD  
EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD is a cutting-edge Electronics Product Design and Engineering firm specializing in embedded systems, IoT solutions, and high-performance hardware development. We provide end-to-end product development services—from PCB design, firmware development, and system architecture to manufacturing and scalable deployment.  
  
With deep expertise in embedded software, signal processing, AI-driven edge computing, RF communication, and ultra-low-power design, we build next-generation industrial automation, consumer electronics, and smart infrastructure solutions.  
  
Our Core Capabilities  
Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering – Architecting robust, real-time embedded solutions with RTOS, Linux, and MCU/SoC-based firmware.  
IoT & Wireless Technologies – Developing LoRa, BLE, Wi-Fi, UWB, and 5G-based connected solutions for industrial and smart city applications.  
Hardware & PCB Design – High-performance PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, and design for manufacturing (DFM/DFA).  
Product Prototyping & Manufacturing – Accelerating concept-to-market with rapid prototyping, design validation, and scalable production.  
AI & Edge Computing – Implementing real-time AI/ML on embedded devices for predictive analytics, automation, and security.  
Security & Cryptography – Integrating post-quantum cryptography, secure boot, and encrypted firmware updates.  
  
Our Industry Impact  
✅ IoT & Smart Devices – Powering the next wave of connected solutions for industrial automation, logistics, and smart infrastructure.  
✅ Medical & Wearable Tech – Designing low-power biomedical devices with precision sensor fusion and embedded intelligence.  
✅ Automotive & Industrial Automation – Developing AI-enhanced control systems, predictive maintenance tools, and real-time monitoring solutions.  
✅ Scalable Enterprise & B2B Solutions – Delivering custom embedded hardware and software tailored to OEMs, manufacturers, and system integrators.  
  
Our Vision  
We are committed to advancing technology and innovation in embedded product design. With a focus on scalability, security, and efficiency, we empower businesses with intelligent, connected, and future-ready solutions.  
  
We currently cater to B2B markets, offering customized embedded development services, with a roadmap to expand into direct-to-consumer (B2C) solutions.

The Control-M Developer is a hands-on developer responsible for designing, developing and supporting enterprise batch scheduling and automation solutions using Control-M within Schwab Data India. The Batch Services team builds and maintains highly secure and reliable batch processing that orchestrates mainframe and distributed workloads across Schwab’s hundreds of applications. This role contributes to the Analytical Data Platform Engineering (ADPE) organization which owns the strategy, implementation, delivery, and support of the data warehouse and emerging data platforms managing over 4 petabytes of data.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Development & Implementation**
--------------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain Control-M jobs, folders, and scheduling solutions across mainframe and distributed platforms.
* Build and support secure, reliable batch workflows including dependencies, calendars, and file transfers (NDM, FTP, SFTP, PGP/FTP, NFS).
* Automate repetitive batch and operational tasks using Python and shell scripting.
* Write clean, well-tested code and Control-M configurations following team standards and best practices.
* AI and Generative AI tools to accelerate development, automate routine tasks, and improve batch operations and observability.
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute ideas for solution improvements.

**Collaboration & Learning**

* Collaborate with team members through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
* Work with application support teams, Production Control, and stakeholders to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate with U.S.-based team members for knowledge transfer and issue resolution.
* Document processes, procedures, and technical implementations.

**Quality & Operations**

* Provide Level 2 support for batch execution, problem determination, and service restoration.
* Follow established CI/CD practices for code and configuration deployment and release management.
* Troubleshoot and debug batch and application issues, providing timely resolutions.
* Adhere to Schwab’s security, privacy, and regulatory standards in all development work.
* Support production deployments and participate in on-call rotation as needed.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Control-M administration and development (mandatory).
* Experience with enterprise batch scheduling across mainframe and distributed (UNIX/LINUX/Windows) environments.
* Working knowledge of JES/SDSF, ISPF, JCL, CA-ESP, CA11, and file transfer protocols (NDM, FTP, SFTP, PGP/FTP, NFS).
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and agile development methodologies.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and understanding of database infrastructure (Oracle, MS-SQL Server, PostgreSQL) (mandatory).

**Preferred Experience**

* Programming experience with Python for automation and scripting.
* Exposure to AI / Machine Learning concepts and the ability to leverage AI-based tools to improve automation and productivity.
* Data Warehouse and ETL knowledge or experience.
* Unix Shell Scripting and PERL knowledge; ability to read and interpret debug logs.

**Skills and Attributes**

* Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.
* Good communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent at gauging customer impact and escalating with the appropriate sense of urgency.
* Team player who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated with a mindset to automate wherever possible and a passion for learning new technologies.
* Adaptable and open to feedback with a growth mindset.

description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

In the role of **Staff Software Engineer, Shop (eCommerce)**, you will report to the Fan Experiences Engineering Organization.

We are considering applicants for the location of Hyderabad, India.

Crunchyroll is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our India Engineering Center and help build the next generation of our member-focused eCommerce platform.

The eCommerce platform is designed to create an exclusive experience for Crunchyroll members, including access to unique products and limited drops. An integral part of the member experience, the platform must be designed to deliver high-quality features, operate reliably at scale, and delight our fans.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the Shop team, helping define the architecture, engineering strategy, and execution approach for critical eCommerce capabilities. You will remain hands-on while operating with a broad perspective: solving complex technical problems, shaping durable platform investments, raising engineering standards, and enabling other engineers to deliver with confidence.

You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Product, Program Management, and other Engineering verticals to align on requirements, priorities, technical trade-offs, and dependencies. You will help turn ambiguous problems into clear technical direction and scalable solutions, while ensuring that features are delivered with strong operational ownership.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can connect customer and business outcomes to pragmatic technical decisions, influence across team and organizational boundaries, and establish patterns that improve the quality, reliability, and velocity of the Shop platform.

**About You**
-------------

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience building and operating cloud-native software, distributed systems, or consumer-facing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience providing staff-level technical leadership across multiple engineers, teams, or services.
* Experience defining and evolving technical strategy and architecture for platforms with meaningful scale, reliability, security, and customer impact.

**About the Team**

The eCommerce team is building and operating a member-focused commerce platform that creates new ways for Crunchyroll fans to engage with the brand. The platform supports differentiated shopping experiences, unique products, and exclusive drops while connecting to broader Crunchyroll capabilities such as membership, identity, payments, entitlements, and customer operations.

This role is an opportunity to shape both the platform and the organization behind it: setting a durable technical direction, developing people, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and helping establish eCommerce as a trusted part of the Crunchyroll member experience.

**Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Automation**

* Design and maintain Azure infrastructure through Terraform and version-controlled Infrastructure as Code.

* Build reusable, composable, and versioned Terraform modules for application, networking, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, and security services.

* Automate infrastructure validation, policy checks, drift detection, security scanning, and controlled promotion across environments.

* Automate application deployments using Docker and Azure services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring.

* Establish safe deployment patterns, including blue-green or canary releases, health checks, automated rollback, and progressive delivery.

* Manage configuration and secrets securely using appropriate Azure services such as Key Vault and managed identities.

**Reliability Engineering**

* Define and implement service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and reliability dashboards for critical applications and delivery systems.

* Support incident response, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement plans.

* Improve mean time to detect, mean time to recover, deployment success rate, and change failure rate.

* Introduce resilience and failure testing for important services and infrastructure.

* Automate health checks, smoke tests, rollback decisions, and post-deployment verification.

**CI/CD and Release Engineering**

* Design and optimize Azure DevOps pipelines for fast, reliable, repeatable builds and releases.

* Implement pipeline stages for validation, compilation, unit testing, API testing, security scanning, container image creation, infrastructure validation, deployment, and post-deployment verification.

* Use dependency and build caching, parallel execution, selective test execution, and incremental pipelines to reduce feedback time.

* Establish quality gates based on test results, coverage, security findings, code quality, infrastructure validation, and release risk.

* Support Git-based development workflows, pull-request validation, branch policies, artifact versioning, and release traceability.

* Automate release evidence, test reports, deployment records, and compliance-related documentation.

**Test Automation and Quality Engineering**

* Define a layered testing strategy across unit, integration, API, contract, component, and end-to-end testing.

* Build and maintain Playwright-based UI and regression suites with traceability, screenshots, videos, logs, and failure diagnostics.

* Improve test reliability through deterministic test data, service virtualization, isolation, parallelization, and environment management.

* Automate test data creation and cleanup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and dependent services.

* Reduce flaky tests and ensure failures are classified as product defects, test defects, infrastructure issues, or environmental issues.

* Partner with engineering and QA teams to make applications easier to test and operate.

* Explore AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, and coverage analysis with appropriate human review.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Graduate with 5-8 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, CI/CD, test automation, or developer-productivity engineering.

* Strong experience building internal developer platforms, delivery automation, or reusable engineering tooling.

* Advanced hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces or equivalent environment strategies, policy validation, and infrastructure testing.

* Strong Azure experience with services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, Key Vault, monitoring, and managed databases.

* Strong experience designing Azure DevOps pipelines and Git-based delivery workflows.

* Practical experience with Docker, container image lifecycle management, registries, health checks, and deployment automation.

* Strong understanding of SRE concepts, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident response, resilience, and operational readiness.

* Hands-on automated testing experience with Playwright or a comparable framework across API and end-to-end layers.

* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and/or Go.

* Working knowledge of Python/Django, Go services, and Angular/TypeScript applications.

* Experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL and Redis for test data, environment setup, integration testing, and operational diagnostics.

* Experience implementing quality gates, security scanning, dependency checks, artifact promotion, and release traceability.

* Ability to troubleshoot complex failures across application code, pipelines, infrastructure, networking, and cloud services.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Kubernetes, Helm, or other container orchestration platforms.

* GitOps and declarative deployment tools.

* OpenTelemetry and modern observability platforms.

* Performance, load, stress, and resilience testing.

* Ephemeral environments and preview deployments for pull requests.

* Backstage or similar internal developer portals.

* Policy as Code using tools such as Open Policy Agent, Checkov, or tfsec.

* Security engineering integrated into CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.

* AI-assisted development, test generation, failure triage, or agent-based engineering workflows.

* Experience defining developer-platform adoption metrics and engineering effectiveness metrics.

* Experience working in regulated or enterprise software environments.

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Strong ownership of developer experience, platform reliability, and delivery outcomes.

* Clear communication and the ability to explain infrastructure and reliability concepts to application teams.

* Pragmatic approach to automation, balancing standardization with team flexibility.

* Bias for measurement, simplification, and continuous improvement.

* Strong troubleshooting and systems-thinking abilities.

* Ability to influence engineering practices without relying on direct reporting authority.

* Willingness to remain hands-on with code, infrastructure, pipelines, and production issues.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

* Equivalent practical experience with a strong record in platform engineering, automation, reliability, or developer productivity may also be considered.

**SUGGESTED SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Reduced CI/CD pipeline duration and time to meaningful developer feedback.

* Increased deployment frequency and deployment success rate.

* Reduced change failure rate and mean time to recovery.

* Increased adoption of reusable Terraform modules, pipeline templates, and golden paths.

* Reduced environment provisioning time.

* Reduced flaky-test rate and test-maintenance effort.

* Improved SLO compliance and production observability coverage.

* Reduced manual release, environment, and operational effort.

title: Software Engineer - BI
description:
Overview:

**Software Engineer – BI**

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Care Solutions GPS BI team at HealthEdge in our Hyderabad office. In this role you will own end-to-end development and delivery of BI reports that power analytics for Care Solutions.

You will bring deep expertise in BI tooling, building reliable and performant reports that help CareSolutions turn complex clinical and operational data into actionable insights. This role partners closely with Business Analysts, Project Managers and data engineering teams to drive report quality, stakeholder trust and continuous platform improvement.

**AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY**

**Report Development and Delivery**

* Own end-to-end analysis, design, development and deployment of enterprise BI solutions across the Care Solutions platform.
* Partner with Business Analysts to translate complex report requirements into actionable insights, providing level-of-effort estimates and aligning delivery timelines with GPS project managers.
* Deliver high-quality standard, custom and enhancement reports within schedule and client expectations.
* Participate in client calls, provide technical updates and represent BI delivery in stakeholder forums.
* Create Jira stories to track report delivery, maintain Confluence documentation and deliver user enablement and training to support adoption.

**BI Development**

* Design and deliver high-performing Tableau and QuickSight dashboards and visualizations.
* Own the development of QuickSight datasets and Tableau data sources end-to-end, partnering with data engineering teams to ensure performant, governed and production-ready reporting solutions.
* Build and maintain automated unit testing frameworks for reports and datasets, ensuring data accuracy and high-quality releases.
* Own report quality across the full delivery lifecycle, enforcing data validation standards and proactively resolving discrepancies before they reach stakeholders.
* Run automated CI/CD pipelines for report and dataset deployments.
* Actively leverage Generative AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor) as thought partners for query optimization, test scaffolding, documentation and insight discovery.
* Stay current with BI, data engineering and cloud platform trends and bring recommendations to the team.

**Governance and Documentation**

* Own and maintain metadata dictionaries, KPI definitions and reporting standards as the authoritative source of truth for BI governance and long-term platform sustainability.
* Monitor automated alerting for Tableau extracts and QuickSight datasets, responding proactively to quality issues before impacting stakeholders.
* Participate in on-call incident triage, performing thorough root-cause analysis, implementing lasting fixes and documenting findings to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for all datasets, data sources and reports, ensuring engineering and analytics teams have a reliable single source of truth.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3-5 years of hands-on experience in BI reports and dashboards delivering enterprise BI solutions integrating with datawarehouse
* Expert Proficiency with AWS QuickSight and Tableau, including dashboard design, report development and data source optimization.
* Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) as active development partners for code generation, test scaffolding, code review and documentation
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL or a related database including SQL development, performance tuning and data modeling.
* Familiarity with AWS data services including S3, Glue, Athena and IAM.
* Familiarity with Git/Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence and DevOps concepts.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum environments.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Experience in the US Healthcare domain and familiarity with HIPAA compliance and healthcare data security standards.
* Experience with report platform migrations.
* Cloud platform certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Data Analytics or similar).

**BEHAVIORS AND TRAITS**

* Strong ownership mindset to follow through, communicate proactively and strive not to repeat the same mistake twice.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and report quality.
* Collaborative across teams, functions and geographies building trust with US and India-based colleagues.
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
* Curious, continuously learning and open to feedback
* Passionate about leveraging technology to improve patient care and health outcomes.
* Champions engineering best practices and raises the bar for the people around them.

title: Sr. SAP ABAP Developer
description:
Dorman was founded on the belief that people should have greater freedom to fix motor vehicles. For over 100 years, we have been driving new solutions, releasing tens of thousands of aftermarket replacement products engineered to save time and money, and increase convenience and reliability. Founded and headquartered in the United States, we are a pioneering global organization offering an always-evolving catalog of automotive, heavy-duty and specialty vehicle products. Today, we have more than 3,800 employees across 29 different locations, with a family of brands that also includes SuperATV and Dayton Parts. Publicly traded under the stock ticker DORM, reaching a revenue of $2.13 billion in 2025.

Everyone who works at Dorman is called a Contributor. We need everyone, regardless of role and experience, to contribute to our success. That means everyone has a unique ability to make an impact on the business. We encourage all our Contributors to bring their authentic selves to work. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Sr SAP ABAP Developer will provide hands-on technical leadership, architecture, design, and solution delivery for SAP application development, workflow automation, integrations, enhancements, and production support. This offshore role requires deep ABAP expertise and proven experience leading delivery teams, defining scalable technical solutions, and integrating SAP with SAP and non-SAP platforms. The position will partner closely with business, functional, architecture, integration, Basis, Security, QA, and U.S.-based teams to deliver secure, maintainable, high-performing solutions across logistics and Order-to-Cash processes.

**Primary Duties**
------------------

* Lead the offshore SAP development team across solution design, project delivery, enhancements, interfaces, workflow, upgrades, releases, defect resolution, and production support.
* Own technical discovery, feasibility analysis, solution architecture, design decisions, effort estimates, delivery plans, technical specifications, and implementation approaches for complex SAP requirements.
* Design and develop scalable Object-Oriented ABAP solutions using classes, interfaces, inheritance, polymorphism, exception classes, design patterns, dependency separation, reusable frameworks, and ABAP Unit.
* Lead SAP Business Workflow design and development, including workflow templates, tasks, events, agents, containers, business objects/classes, deadlines, escalations, substitutions, work-item administration, email notifications, debugging, monitoring, and restart/recovery procedures.
* Architect and deliver SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integrations using ALE/IDoc, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, SOAP, web services, APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware, and event-driven patterns as applicable.
* Own inbound and outbound ALE/IDoc solutions, including message types, basic types, extensions, custom segments, partner profiles, ports, process codes, distribution models, change pointers, serialization, status management, monitoring, error handling, and reprocessing.
* Design and support dialog and Module Pool applications, including screen flow logic, PBO/PAI processing, table controls, tab strips, custom controls, validations, locking, authorizations, transaction design, and maintainable separation of presentation and business logic.
* Lead RF development for warehouse execution, including RF screens, logical transactions, menus, function codes, barcode/scanning flows, device considerations, validations, exception handling, performance, and operational troubleshooting.
* Partner with functional teams to design solutions across SAP Logistics Execution and Order-to-Cash, including sales orders, deliveries, picking, packing, warehouse operations, post goods issue, transportation, billing, outputs, and related integration touchpoints.
* Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews; enforce standards for performance, security, maintainability, error handling, naming, documentation, testability, and transport discipline.
* Use ABAP Test Cockpit, Code Inspector, ABAP Unit, SQL analysis, runtime analysis, traces, and security checks to improve code quality and prevent critical issues from progressing across the landscape.
* Promote SAP-standard, upgrade-stable solutions and clean-core principles through released APIs, approved enhancement technologies, side-by-side extensions, and disciplined management of custom code and technical debt.
* Lead root-cause analysis for complex cross-system incidents and determine whether corrective action belongs to custom code, configuration, master data, workflow, middleware, authorization, network, or infrastructure.
* Plan and assign work, manage priorities and dependencies, review deliverables, coach developers, build technical capability, and maintain delivery accountability across onsite and offshore teams.
* Coordinate testing, transports, release readiness, cutover, go-live, hypercare, incident response, and production stabilization; communicate status, risks, options, and recovery plans to technical and business stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through reusable assets, automation, observability, performance optimization, technical-debt reduction, development standards, and knowledge-sharing practices.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA development and transformation programs, including modern ABAP syntax, ADT, CDS views, AMDP, RAP, OData, custom-code remediation, and simplification-item impact analysis.
* Experience applying clean-core principles, released APIs, approved extension methods, ATC governance, security checks, and upgrade-stable extensibility patterns.
* Experience with SAP BTP, Integration Suite or comparable middleware, event-driven integration, API management, side-by-side extensions, or SAP Build Process Automation.
* Experience with EWM, LE-TRA, SAP Transportation Management, output management, Fiori/UI5, Web Dynpro ABAP, or warehouse and transportation-system integrations.
* Automotive, automotive aftermarket, discrete manufacturing, distribution, or a similar high-volume logistics industry background is an advantage. Familiarity with EDI-driven customer and supplier processes, scheduling agreements, advance shipping notices, labeling, warehouse execution, and high-volume order fulfillment is beneficial.
* SAP certification in ABAP, S/4HANA, integration, workflow, BTP, or logistics is preferred but not required.

**Education / Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 12-15 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience, with substantial experience as a Technical Lead, Development Lead, or Solution Lead in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven leadership experience managing or coordinating SAP development teams, mentoring developers, reviewing technical deliverables, managing estimates and priorities, and collaborating across global time zones.
* Expert-level Object-Oriented ABAP experience, including solution architecture, reusable frameworks, exception handling, testable design, performance optimization, and complex debugging.
* Strong SAP Business Workflow experience with end-to-end workflow design, development, enhancement, agent determination, event linkage, deadline and escalation handling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong SAP and non-SAP integration experience using ALE/IDoc, RFC, BAPI, APIs, OData, REST, SOAP, web services, files, and enterprise middleware or integration platforms.
* Strong inbound and outbound ALE/IDoc development and support experience, including custom types/extensions, interface recovery, duplicate prevention, high-volume processing, monitoring, and production issue resolution.
* Strong hands-on experience with Module Pool programming and dialog applications, including screen design, PBO/PAI, table controls, custom controls, validations, authorizations, and transaction handling.
* Hands-on RF development experience supporting warehouse mobile transactions, scanning workflows, RF screens, logical transactions, menus, function codes, device behavior, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated design and solutioning experience, including requirements analysis, fit-gap assessment, technical architecture, integration design, non-functional requirements, estimates, risks, prototypes, design documentation, and stakeholder presentations.
* Experience with ABAP Dictionary, reports, ALV, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits, BTEs, BAPIs, RFCs, forms, application logs, background jobs, conversions, and performance tuning.
* Functional and technical understanding of SAP Logistics Execution, Shipping, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and end-to-end Order-to-Cash processes.
* Experience with software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, change control, transport management, incident and problem management, release governance, cutover, and production support.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain architecture, technical trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to both technical and business audiences.

**Shape the Future of Aerospace. Engineer What’s Next.**
--------------------------------------------------------

At **RTX**, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 innovators come together with a shared purpose: solving the world’s most complex challenges and making a meaningful difference. Through our industry-leading businesses, advanced research, and cutting-edge technologies, we are redefining what’s possible in aerospace and defense.

**Collins Aerospace**, an RTX business, is at the forefront of developing intelligent, technologically advanced solutions that connect and protect our world. Our innovations help shape the future of flight, enhance aircraft capabilities, and enable safer, smarter, and more connected aviation systems.

Are you ready to work on software that powers the future of airborne communication?

We are looking for an experienced **Principal Engineer – Avionics Communication & Data Link Systems** to join our Airborne Information Solutions Department within the Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) division. As part of the End-to-End Communication Team, you will contribute to the development, verification, integration, and certification of advanced avionics communication applications that support reliable, safety-critical airborne connectivity.

This is an opportunity to apply your software engineering expertise to complex aerospace challenges, work with industry-leading avionics standards, and help deliver mission-critical technologies that keep aircraft and the global aviation ecosystem connected.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As part of our avionics software engineering team, you will:

* **Design and develop advanced avionics software:** Contribute to the architecture, development, integration, and verification of airborne communication applications using C, C++, and Python.
* **Engineer next-generation data link solutions:** Develop and verify applications supporting Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC), Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C), ATN Context Management (CM), and FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).
* **Apply industry-leading aviation standards:** Implement and maintain compliance with relevant ARINC standards, including ARINC 429, 618, 620, 622, 661, 739, and 615.
* **Deliver certification-ready software:** Apply DO-178B/C processes and contribute to the development of high-integrity, safety-critical software that meets stringent aviation certification objectives.
* **Drive software quality and verification:** Perform requirements analysis, verification and validation (V&V), structural coverage analysis (SCA), debugging, troubleshooting, and unit, integration, white-box, and verification testing.
* **Enable seamless system integration:** Support software-software and hardware-software integration, identify complex system-level issues, and drive effective technical resolutions.
* **Support certification and compliance activities:** Prepare for and participate in Stages of Involvement (SOI), certification reviews, technical audits, and engagements with internal and external compliance authorities.
* **Collaborate across engineering disciplines:** Work closely with systems, software, integration, verification, and certification teams to deliver robust, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
* **Strengthen engineering excellence:** Contribute to requirements management, reliability analysis, risk mitigation, process optimization, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.
* **Leverage advanced engineering tools:** Use network analyzers, simulation environments, and software development and verification tools to validate performance and troubleshoot complex avionics systems.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech/M.Tech), with a foundation in avionics systems and software architecture.
* **12+ years of avionics software development and verification experience.**
* Strong programming proficiency in C or C++ and Python.
* Solid understanding of avionics systems and architectures, including Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), Flight Control Systems (FCS), and aircraft displays.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), covering requirements analysis, software design, coding, integration, verification, and validation.
* Practical exposure to DO-178B/C processes and safety-critical software development.
* Hands-on experience with V&V, structural coverage analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and white-box, unit, integration, and verification testing.
* Experience with software development and verification tools such as VectorCAST, PyATE, RapiTest, Git, and Subversion.
* Familiarity with real-time operating systems and network analyzer tools used for communication and performance testing.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile engineering environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing, integrating, and certifying large-scale avionics software systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety-critical software architecture, design principles, and development practices.
* Practical experience with airborne communication and data link protocols, including applicable ARINC standards.
* Familiarity with avionics simulation environments and system-level testing.
* Experience supporting formal certification reviews, SOI activities, compliance audits, and certification evidence preparation.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and drive issues through to resolution.

**What You’ll Gain**
--------------------

At Collins Aerospace, your work contributes to technologies that have a direct impact on the future of aviation.

* **Meaningful engineering challenges:** Work on advanced avionics communication applications that support aircraft connectivity and operational safety.
* **Technical depth and innovation:** Apply your expertise in embedded software, data link protocols, real-time systems, and safety-critical engineering.
* **End-to-end product exposure:** Participate across the software lifecycle, from requirements and design through verification, integration, and certification.
* **Collaborative engineering:** Partner with experienced professionals across software, systems, integration, and certification disciplines.

title: Automation Test Engineer - C#
description:
As a Senior SDET, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust automated test solutions.

The role requires strong software engineering and test automation skills, with hands-on experience developing automation frameworks, test tools, and automated test scenarios. You will work across applications, operating systems, and CI/CD environments, including Linux, to troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the product.

You will contribute to the overall test automation strategy, continuously improve automation frameworks, and work closely with developers, testers, architects, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, maintain, and enhance SDET-level test automation frameworks and tools for the E3D Design application.

* Develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated tests using appropriate programming languages and automation technologies.

* Analyze product requirements and technical specifications to identify comprehensive test scenarios and automation opportunities.

* Build reusable automation components and utilities to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and maintainability.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and ensure reliable execution across supported environments.

* Work hands-on with Linux operating systems, including installation/configuration, command-line utilities, shell scripting, process management, file systems, permissions, environment configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Develop and execute automated tests in Linux-based environments and investigate issues related to application behaviour, dependencies, configuration, and system resources.

* Strong knowledge of AI agents and agentic workflows, with the ability to translate testing requirements into scalable AI-driven automation solutions and identify opportunities to improve test coverage and efficiency.

* Troubleshoot and debug automation failures and product issues across applications, framework, and operating-system layers.

* Analyze logs, crash reports, test results, and system behaviour to identify root causes and work with development teams to resolve defects.

* Contribute to improving test automation reliability by identifying and reducing flaky tests.

* Participate in code reviews and follow software engineering best practices for automation code.

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional and distributed teams to plan, execute, and deliver testing activities within agreed timelines.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, frameworks, and engineering practices.

Desired Experience

* 8+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, SDET, or a related software engineering role within a product/project development environment.

* Strong hands-on experience in software test automation and automation framework development, with the ability to write production-quality automation code.

* Strong programming experience in C#, .NET, Python, or other relevant programming languages.

* Hands-on experience working with Linux operating systems, including command-line operations, shell scripting, process management, file permissions, environment variables, package/dependency management, system troubleshooting, and log analysis.

* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks for Desktop and Web applications and building comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance tests.

* Good understanding of CI/CD practices and Azure DevOps, including automated test execution and integration of test automation into pipelines.

* Experience with source control, code reviews, build systems, and software development practices.

* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and risk-based test coverage.

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

* Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and prioritization skills.

* Self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a collaborative engineering environment.

Great Skills to Have

Software Engineering & Automation

* Strong understanding of SDET principles and automation architecture.

* Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation frameworks.

* Experience improving automation stability, execution time, coverage, and reliability.

* Experience identifying opportunities to replace repetitive manual testing with automation.

Linux & System Troubleshooting

* Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based environments.

* Comfortable using the Linux command line for application deployment, configuration, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.

* Familiarity with emulators and compatibility layers in Linux environments, particularly Wine/Proton, including basic understanding of their architecture, configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Experience with shell scripting and Linux utilities.

* Ability to investigate application crashes, processes, permissions, environment configuration, dependencies, and system/resource issues.

Quality & Problem Solving

* Passion for delivering software that is reliable, performant, and scalable.

* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex problems across application, automation, and operating-system layers.

* Ability to analyze failures and identify root causes rather than simply reporting symptoms.

Collaboration & Delivery

* Effective communication and collaboration with developers, testers, product teams, and other stakeholders.

* Strong ownership of deliverables, with the ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.

* Good time management, prioritization, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.
