description:
**Senior Software Engineer – C# .net**

**Location: Hyderabad / Noida**

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

Join the Standard Configuration Framework area to develop XMGR, SimCorp’s configuration-management platform for SimCorp Dimension. You will help make configuration changes reliable, repeatable and traceable across development, test and production environments, supporting both cloud-hosted and on-premises deployments.

This is a hands-on, C#/.NET-focused senior engineering role with opportunities to contribute across the stack. XMGR combines ASP.NET Core APIs, an Angular/TypeScript UI, Entity Framework Core and relational databases, with asynchronous messaging and workflow processing. You will evolve an established platform and turn complex configuration requirements into maintainable software.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build and evolve C#/.NET services and ASP.NET Core APIs
* Design reliable asynchronous workflows with clear failure handling, safe retries and useful diagnostics, protecting configuration integrity when operations fail or are interrupted.
* Improve security, authorization, auditability, performance and observability; diagnose issues across application and integration boundaries.
* Improve automated unit and integration testing, code review and CI/CD; refactor existing code incrementally while preserving compatibility and behaviour
Provide technical leadership through design discussions, mentoring and knowledge sharing; collaborate across engineering, configuration and platform teams to deliver the team’s definition of done.  

  

**WHAT WE VALUE**

* Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience ranging from 3 to 5 years developing production software in C#/.NET, with evidence of owning complex features and making sound technical decisions
* Experience building ASP.NET Core services and REST APIs, including API contracts, asynchronous programming, dependency injection and robust error handling.
* Practical application of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and appropriate design patterns; ability to navigate, debug and safely improve an established codebase.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL, using Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM; understand data modelling, validation, serialization and schema compatibility.
* Understanding of reliable distributed or long-running operations: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures, with the ability to diagnose problems using logs and telemetry.
* Strong automated unit and integration testing skills; experience with peer reviews, Git and CI/CD, and a commitment to maintainability, security and release quality.
Ability to clarify requirements with domain stakeholders and collaborate in an Agile team; willingness to work across backend APIs and web UI when a feature requires it.  

  

**DESIRABLE**

* Experience with configuration-management or deployment-automation systems: versioned artifacts, dependency resolution, environment promotion, baseline comparison or audit trails.
* Angular and TypeScript experience, particularly reactive programming with RxJS and state management such as NgRx.
* Asynchronous messaging (for example NATS), OData APIs, Oracle or SQL Server, and application telemetry such as OpenTelemetry.
* Azure, enterprise authentication/authorization, Docker or Kubernetes, and automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience modernizing .NET applications while preserving integration compatibility; familiarity with NUnit, NSubstitute or equivalent testing tools.
* Experience in enterprise or financial software; familiarity with SimCorp Dimension is welcome but not required.

Prior experience with XMGR or the Standard Configuration Framework is not required; you should be willing to learn the product and configuration domain.

  

**PERSONAL COMPETENCIES**

* Take responsibility for, apply sound judgement and balance delivery with long-term quality
* Work constructively across cultures and disciplines; share knowledge, mentor colleagues and contribute to an inclusive team environment.
Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including technical decisions and documentation.  

  

**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

  

**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Salesforce Agentforce
description:
About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

Role Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Salesforce Agentforce engineering team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

• Department: Technology – Agentforce / Supply Chain • Location: Pune / Hyderabad, India • Experience: 5–8 Years • Employment Type: Full-Time

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Salesforce application development, particularly Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and enterprise integrations.

The role involves designing, developing, and enhancing Salesforce-based solutions, including AI-powered customer service capabilities, case management workflows, conversational agents, and enterprise integrations.

The engineer will work closely with product managers, architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent solutions that improve customer experience and business operations.

Impact of the Role

• Independently develop and deliver Salesforce features and integrations. • Contribute to Agentforce and AI-powered customer service initiatives. • Build secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise solutions. • Take technical ownership of assigned components and features. • Collaborate across engineering, QA, product, and architecture teams. • Continuously improve engineering quality through automation and AI-assisted development.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• Salesforce, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Salesforce Agentforce • Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows • Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Einstein AI, and Prompt Builder • Salesforce Case Management and workflow automation • REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and enterprise integration mechanisms • Asynchronous Apex, triggers, batch processing, and platform events • Conversational AI, chatbots, generative AI, and AI agents • Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) • Voice platforms, contact center applications, and conversational AI solutions • Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service applications, and backend microservices • Java, Spring Boot, and microservices • Event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and asynchronous integrations • Salesforce development tools, Git, CI/CD pipelines, debugging, and unit testing • AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Codex

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Application Development

• Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows. • Build and enhance Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities, including Case Management, workflow automation, and customer service processes. • Develop reusable components, custom business logic, and integrations following Salesforce best practices. • Optimize application performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Agentforce & AI-Powered Solutions

• Develop and enhance Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to support AI-powered customer interactions. • Work on conversational AI solutions, including chatbots, order tracking, customer assistance, and knowledge-based responses. • Configure and integrate Agentforce topics, actions, instructions, and business workflows. • Collaborate with the team to improve agent accuracy, reliability, and customer experience. • Explore opportunities to automate business processes using Agentforce and generative AI.

Enterprise Integration & API Development

• Design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST APIs and other integration mechanisms. • Integrate Salesforce with Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service applications, and backend microservices. • Implement secure API communication, authentication, error handling, and asynchronous processing. • Collaborate with backend engineering teams to ensure reliable data exchange across enterprise systems.

Case Management & Customer Experience

• Develop and enhance Salesforce Case Management workflows, including case creation, routing, assignment, escalation, and resolution. • Implement business rules, validations, approval workflows, and service automation. • Support customer service use cases such as order status, delivery inquiries, and customer support requests. • Work with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Voice Integration & Data-Driven AI

• Contribute to integrating Agentforce with voice-based customer service and conversational AI platforms. • Support the development of AI-powered interactions across chat and voice channels. • Work with Salesforce Data Cloud and enterprise knowledge sources to improve contextual customer interactions. • Participate in implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge-based AI capabilities.

Engineering Excellence & Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned features from technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design sessions. • Develop unit tests and support automated testing to ensure software quality. • Troubleshoot complex application issues and perform root-cause analysis. • Follow CI/CD, secure coding, and engineering best practices. • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity. • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

• 5–8 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on Salesforce development expertise. • Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows. • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, including Case Management and workflow automation. • Strong understanding of Salesforce data models, security, permissions, and application architecture. • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs, JSON, and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0. • Experience with asynchronous Apex, triggers, batch processing, and platform events. • Good understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software engineering principles. • Experience with Salesforce development tools, Git, CI/CD pipelines, debugging, and unit testing. • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce, including agent configuration, topics, actions, and conversational workflows. • Exposure to Salesforce Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, and generative AI capabilities. • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, knowledge integration, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Understanding of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI agent concepts. • Experience integrating Salesforce with voice platforms, contact center applications, or conversational AI solutions. • Familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise integration architectures. • Experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service platforms, or retail/e-commerce applications. • Knowledge of event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and asynchronous integrations. • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex. • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce Agentforce Specialist, or relevant Salesforce certifications.

Professional Skills

• Strong communication and collaboration skills. • Ability to independently handle moderately complex technical assignments. • Good understanding of business requirements and ability to translate them into technical solutions. • Proactive approach to identifying technical risks and resolving issues. • Willingness to learn emerging Salesforce and AI technologies. • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on quality, reliability, and timely delivery. • Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed onshore and offshore teams.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. • 5–8 years of relevant software engineering experience. • Strong practical experience delivering enterprise Salesforce applications.

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

 Job Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Android Software Engineer who possesses in\-depth knowledge of the Android ecosystem, a passion for security\-first development, and a strong product commitment. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and securing new features for our primary Android mobile products.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Leadership: Drive the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of our core Android solutions, ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing, delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Security \& Best Practices: Define and evangelize development best practices with a strict focus on code robustness, mobile security, scalability, and performance.
* Collaboration \& Alignment: Work closely with Product Management, Sales, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to align on product roadmaps and backend API design.
* Customer \& Field Support: Interface with Support and field teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer escalations in large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Mentorship: Lead brainstorming and design sessions, providing ongoing technical direction and code reviews for teammates across multiple global sites.
* Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve regarding evolving mobile technologies, Android OS updates, and relevant open\-source libraries.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with 3\+ years dedicated to the Android platform and at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, alongside a deep understanding of core Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
* Deep understanding of modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, MVP) and UI patterns (including Material Design).
* Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming concepts.
* Experience with Android testing frameworks (Espresso, JUnit) and a solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven knowledge of code signing and distributing applications through the Google Play Store, as well as managing dependencies via Maven/Gradle.
* Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and token\-based authentication.
* Familiarity with user directory concepts like Active Directory, user groups, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and security policies.
* Understanding of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), PKI, certificate security, encryption, and secure data storage on mobile devices.
* Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS).
* Understanding of no\-schema (NoSQL) databases and local mobile data persistence.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of iOS development (Swift, Objective\-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross\-platform mobile initiatives.

* Experience or interest in full\-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel\-mode development.

**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.

* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services.
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes**
**Essential:**
* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands\-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desirable:**
* 5\+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. title: SB-1501-Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership**.
The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
The candidate will work extensively on **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization**.
The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Development \& Technical Architecture**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using **C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies**.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.

### **Application Security \& Authentication**

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement **bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing** and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.
* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.
* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.
* Implement and review **RSA, AES/symmetric encryption, hashing, encryption/decryption, key rotation, and secure key\-management practices**.
* Implement secure migration and re\-encryption of existing sensitive database values.
* Integrate applications with **Azure Key Vault** for RSA keys, symmetric keys, secrets, and tokenized credentials.
* Review and secure authentication cookies, including **Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite** attributes.
* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and **rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints**.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply **OWASP secure coding principles** and security best practices throughout development.

### **Code Review \& Technical Governance**

* Act as the primary technical reviewer for code delivered by other developers.
* Perform detailed **code reviews and architecture reviews** across backend components.
* Vet implementations for correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, performance, and architectural compliance.
* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from **SonarQube and vulnerability scans** are appropriately addressed.

### **Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability**

* Work with **Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services**.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement **correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability** across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.

### **Testing \& Quality**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review **unit and integration tests** for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in **Azure DevOps**.

### **Team Leadership \& Delivery**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to developers working on the project.
* Break down complex technical requirements into appropriate implementation approaches.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem\-solving.
* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies early and communicate them to the Engineering/Delivery team.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project management teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Take ownership of technical quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed architecture, security, and coding standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, retrospectives, and client\-facing technical discussions where required.

### **AI\-Driven Development**

* Actively use **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve development speed, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI\-powered engineering tools**.
* Apply AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development practices across requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Use AI tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, and code analysis while maintaining engineering review and security controls.
* Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, architectural compliance, performance, and maintainability before integration.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows within the team.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

**Domain** **Skills \& Technologies** **Must / Preferred**  

Backend Development C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework 4\.x, REST APIs **Must**  


Architecture Enterprise application architecture, scalable architecture, SOLID, design patterns, clean architecture, technical design **Must**

title: Agentic AI Developer
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role:**

Azurity is seeking an Agentic AI Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi\-step autonomous workflows that integrate with internal systems and business processes.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design and build AI agents that use large language models to plan, reason, and execute multi\-step tasks, including data retrieval, document generation, and cross\-system workflows
* Integrate agents with internal and third\-party systems via APIs, MCP servers, and other tool\-calling frameworks
* Build and maintain orchestration layers for multi\-agent workflows, including error handling, retries, and human\-in\-the\-lead checkpoints


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Three or more years of professional software development experience, including at least one year working directly with large language models or agentic AI systems
* Strong proficiency in Python or a similar language, with experience using large language model APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable providers
* Hands\-on experience building tool\-calling or function\-calling agents, including designing tool schemas and managing multi\-turn reasoning
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks and concepts (ReAct, planning/reflection loops, multi\-agent coordination)
* Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and embedding models
* Solid understanding of API design, integration patterns, and asynchronous systems
* Experience implementing evaluation, observability, and safety guardrails for AI systems in production
* Comfort working in a regulated industry, with attention to data privacy, security, and compliance requirements
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions and explain AI system behavior to non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool\-integration standards
* Experience with enterprise systems commonly used in pharmaceutical environments, such as Veeva, Salesforce, ERP, or IT service management platforms
* Background in prompt engineering and fine\-tuning/evaluation of LLMs
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Corp Eng
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

  

At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
